note: Merge order. Every branch is read-only for the integrator. `never`: branches that must never be merged (their history holds a parked contract, or a prototype that is not for use). `forbiddenPaths`: paths that no commit in the history of a merged tip may ever have touched. `preRound18` / `lastVerified`: the commit of the line when round 18 started (2026-11-17 03:20 UTC stop; a coordinator WIP commit where the agent was cut off) and the last commit whose suites the line's own report recorded; the regression check compares against both.
